singlecode='''from collections import deque
\n\ndef _components(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row},key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=set()
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.add((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color,cells))
    return out
\ndef transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; comps=_components(grid)
    markers=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells];cs=[c for r,c in cells];r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if len(cells)!=r1-r0+c1-c0+1 or min(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)<3: continue
        for er,ec in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)):
            if all((er,c) in cells for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all((r,ec) in cells for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
                markers.append((color,cells,er,ec));break
    for color,marker,er,ec in markers:
        small=[(min(abs(r-y)+abs(c-x) for r,c in cells for y,x in marker),cells) for oc,cells in comps if cells is not marker and len(cells)==1]
        if small:
            target=min(small,key=lambda a:a[0])[1]
            for r,c in target: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
